title: fix(service-knowledge)!: retire the knowledge field gate's title arm behind a per-source recipe proof
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Fixes #37467

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the knowledge field gate or its refusals (`git grep` of `skills/objectstack-ai` for the gate, the display field and `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED`: 0 hits)
Security-touching: yes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：知识检索的权限过滤不再额外检查名为“标题”的旧字段；对象同时有“标题”字段和另一个显示字段的知识源，只有在索引确认按当前方式完整建成后才对非系统用户开放，而且每条命中都要与记录的当前内容核对，对不上的不返回。
- 为什么做：知识检索收口（知识库检索按调用者权限过滤）的遗留清理：旧索引兼容分支退役，改为按知识源确认索引、按命中核对内容。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这类知识源在重建完成前检索不到内容（会明确报“需要重建”），或刚改过的个别记录暂时搜不到（后台自动补写）；不会泄露无权字段，改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：审阅这次安全相关的收紧，决定是否合并。

## What changes

- **The field gate's `title` arm is gone** (`knowledge-source-admission.ts`, `servedFieldsOf`). The gate asks about exactly what a document carries under the current recipe: each `content` and `metadataFields` member and the display field (`documentTitleField`), less the fields an index never carries.
- **Per-source proof at search time** (`KnowledgeService.unprovenIndex`, from `planSearches`). `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle` names the sources where the retired arm mattered: the object declares a field named `title` (or its fields cannot be enumerated), the index may carry it, and the source does not serve it. For a non-system caller such a source is searched only when its adapter's `indexStatus` reports the fingerprint AND the recipe hash `planIndex` computes now, and only where the builds that record that hash purge. It is never proven for `refresh.onRecordChange: false`, or on an adapter with no `indexStatus`, no `completeBuild` or no `listDocuments`.
- **Per-hit check on a proven source** (`KnowledgeService.dropUnverifiedHits`; the seat's ruling S1 = B). The proof speaks for the index as its last complete build left it. So each hit of a proven source is served only when (a) one system-context read per source per search round, `where` AND `id` in the hits' record ids, answers its record, (b) its `documentId` is the one the source derives from that record, and (c) its stored `docHash` equals the one `recordToDocument` computes from the row under the current object definition. The hash covers the title. Every way the check cannot be made drops the hit: the read throws or answers no list, the hit has no `sourceRecordId` or no stored hash, the hash cannot be computed, or the tenancy posture cannot be read. The read decides survival only. A surviving hit is returned as the store answered it, and nothing the read returned is put on it. A stale or missing record's own document is repaired in the background through the existing `repairStale`, once per document until a later search finds it current; a document under a foreign id is dropped and not repaired. Under record granularity `checkFreshness` then reads the same records again, so "one read" is the new check's own cost.
- **Without the proof the source is refused, never served through the old arm**: named in `refused` as `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` / 409. That code is already in `@objectstack/service-knowledge`'s error-code ledger, which this PR does not change. A search where it was the only source refuses whole. The caller and the operator are told what ends the refusal: a complete rebuild, nothing (a configuration no build can prove), or the next search (an unreadable status). A refused search starts no build and writes nothing.
- **A source that needs the index proof is never searched without it.** The adapter a source binds to is resolved once per search, in `planSearches`: the proof is read from that instance, both search rounds search that same instance, and a source whose adapter does not resolve at the plan carries the coded refusal its resolution answered and is refused, never searched. `searchRound` no longer looks an adapter up.
- **Every other source pays nothing**: no proof read and no per-hit read when the object declares no `title`, its display field is `title`, `title` is credential-class or `internal`, or the source serves `title` itself.
- **Save door (ADR-0161 K4 guard two)**: the same `servedFieldsOf` judges a save, so an author no longer needs to query a `title` field the source never indexes. This is the widening half of the declaration; the display field is still asked.
- Docs: `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` (the title rule, the proof, the permanent cases, the per-hit check) and `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` (the second cause of `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED`).

## Measurements: the per-hit read

Method, enough to rebuild it (the script is not committed: it imports the in-memory driver from its source by relative path, which is not a dependency of this package):

- Engine and driver: `new ObjectQL()` from `@objectstack/objectql`, `registerDriver(new InMemoryDriver(), true)` with `InMemoryDriver` imported from `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index`, then `init()`. One object `account` (text `name`, text `title`, textarea `body`) registered with `registry.registerObject`.
- Rows: 2,000, inserted in the system context: `name` "Acme i", `title` "T i", `body` "body text i " repeated 40 times.
- Source and service: object source `s` over `account`, `content: ['body']`; `new KnowledgeService({ dataEngine: engine })` with a stub adapter registered as `memory`.
- Hits: for each size n in 5, 25 and 100, the first n rows read in the system context; each hit's `documentId` is `s:ID`, its `sourceRecordId` the row id, and its `docHash` `recordToDocument(source, source.source, row, engine.getSchema('account')).docHash`. So every hit is current.
- Timing: call `dropUnverifiedHits(hits, new Set(['s']))` 20 times to warm up, then 200 timed rounds per size with `performance.now()`; p50 and p95 from the sorted times. `engine.find` is wrapped to count system-context calls (round trips) and the rows they return (rows read).
- Re-run: put the file in `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/`, run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 FILE`, delete it.
- Box: the shared container, beside sibling verify runs; load averages (1, 5, 15 min) 8.07, 7.98, 7.60 at the run. Read the times as an upper bound on CPU cost. A remote driver adds one database round trip per proven source per round.

| hits checked | when | round trips per round | rows read per round | p50 | p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | small: one `topK` 5 page of hits | 1 | 5 | 1.5 ms | 2.5 ms |
| 25 | first round at `topK` 5 (`SEARCH_FIRST_ROUND_FACTOR` 5) | 1 | 25 | 3.3 ms | 7.6 ms |
| 100 | refill at `topK` 5 (`SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR` 20) | 1 | 100 | 9.2 ms | 14.5 ms |

An earlier run of the same method at load about 7 read 1.6/5.1, 3.3/6.2 and 9.5/12.3 ms (p50/p95).

Rows read are bounded by the distinct record ids among the round's hits of proven sources, projected to the fields assembly reads. Every hit was served in every timed round, so the recomputed hash agrees with the stored one end to end on the real engine.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts`:

- proven index: a caller who may not query `title` is served, and the stored hit is returned unchanged;
- unproven, seven ways (no `indexStatus`, no `completeBuild`, no `listDocuments`, no recipe hash, another recipe hash, another fingerprint, a throwing `indexStatus`) plus `refresh.onRecordChange: false`: refused `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` / 409, never searched. The caller message and the warn line promise a rebuild only where one ends the refusal, and the system context is still served;
- per-hit check (new `describe`): CONTROL served with exactly one system read; the read's fields never reach the caller; dropped for a stored hash that is not the current one, a hit whose stored docHash differs from the record's current build inputs, a document a complete build kept, a foreign `documentId`, no hash, an empty hash, and a record the read no longer answers; fails closed for a read that throws, one that answers no list, an unreadable tenancy posture, a hash that cannot be computed, and a hit with no `sourceRecordId`; a source with a `where`: the system read asks for `{ $and: [where, { id: { $in } }] }` and a record outside `where` is dropped; the refill round: a proven source saturates the first round with stale hits, the refill runs, and its stale hits are dropped while its current hit is served; a source searched without the proof is not checked; two race pins for the rule that a source that needs the index proof is never searched without it: another adapter instance registered under the same id while the proof is read is not searched, and an adapter that registers only after its source was planned is not searched that search (the source is refused `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503);
- an unproven source beside a searchable one; sources where the arm never mattered read nothing; rebuilt: refused (no `beginBuild`, `upsert` or `completeBuild` call), then `rebuildSource` completes and the source is served;
- reverse pins: on a proven index the display field, a `content` field and a `metadataFields` field the caller may not query each still refuse the source; on an unproven index a stored earlier-rule title never reaches the caller;
- `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle` table; save door.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1, per-source proof at search time: `unprovenIndex` reads `indexStatus` against `planIndex`'s fingerprint and recipe hash on every search that needs it, never cached. It adds no contract member and no stored state.
- Card acceptance 2: the arm is removed for proven sources. Unproven ones are refused and are rebuilt by the existing boot pass, reload, reconcile or `os knowledge rebuild`, never served through the old arm. On a proven source a hit the current recipe would not assemble from the live record is not served either (seat ruling S1 = B).
- Card acceptance 3: no other arm changed; reverse pins above.
- Seat conditions for B: (1) each fail-closed case pinned and ablated, as above. (2) The no-leak pin plus its ablation. (3) The `indexStatus` proof is kept beside the per-hit check rather than dropped. (4) Measurements above. (5) `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` is kept with messages that say what ends each refusal, and the ledger is unchanged. (6) Withdrawn by the seat (it concerned a follow-up card). The ruling is recorded on this PR (7224861986); the PR keeps `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Security-touching: yes`, and lands the Tier H way through the seat.
- The claim's `:178` is not the arm: `documentTitleField` answering `title` for an object with no definition is the current assembly rule, so the gate keeps asking about it.
- Narrowing, declared for the seat: for a non-system caller, a qualifying source is refused until a complete build under the current recipe has completed (for good under `refresh.onRecordChange: false` or an adapter missing `indexStatus`, `completeBuild` or `listDocuments`). On a proven source, a hit whose record changed after its document was written is dropped until the document is rewritten, and an adapter whose hits carry no `docHash` serves no hit from it (the built-in adapters carry it). Under `buildAtBoot: false` only the reconcile, where it runs, or `os knowledge rebuild SOURCE` ends the first.
- Merged with main after #37306 landed (f10feed8bc). The one `planSearches` conflict keeps both intents: the adapter is the one the source binds to (main's optional-adapter placement) and the index-proof requirement stays on the admitted entry. Review point S5 is on top of it (3a69848a55): a source that needs the index proof is never searched without it. For every source, an adapter that registers mid-search is used from the next search on.
- Deviation: with the shared verify lock held by sibling batteries through repeated 540 s queue-timeouts (five runs queued ahead at the last try), the package suite, typecheck, single-file runs, ablations and the measurement ran unlocked at `--maxWorkers=2`. The dogfood battery ran under the lock.

## Verification

Read first: `knowledge-service.ts` `dropUnverifiedHits` (the per-hit check and its fail-closed exits), then `planSearches`, `searchRound` and `unprovenIndex` (the adapter resolved once, the refusal and the comparison), then `knowledge-source-admission.ts` `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle` (which sources pay either read).

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts` shows 83 passed, including the `per-hit check` block.
